title: PortfolioHistoryResult
description: Live-account-view output. Returned by exec-svc's portfolio_history Activity from Alpaca /v2/account/portfolio/history. Parallel arrays indexed by timestamps[] (epoch seconds): equity[] (the chart line), profit_loss[] and profit_loss_pct[] (the range-aware headline). Scalars: base_value (the dashed baseline / range start), base_value_asof (epoch seconds of the baseline, optional), timeframe (the resolved Alpaca timeframe). Equity is account-level — SHARED across every tenant routing to a broker_target — NOT this tenant's portfolio value. Optional fields stay out of required (a null/absent value means unavailable); a degraded read yields empty arrays.

timestamps.description: Epoch-seconds index shared by equity[], profit_loss[], and profit_loss_pct[].

equity.description: Account net-liquidation equity at each timestamp (the chart line).

profit_loss.description: Range-aware P&L (equity - base_value) at each timestamp.

profit_loss_pct.description: Range-aware P&L percent at each timestamp.

base_value.description: The baseline / range-start equity (the dashed baseline). Null/absent means unavailable.

base_value_asof.description: Epoch seconds the base_value is as-of. Optional.

timeframe.description: The resolved Alpaca timeframe (echoes the request).
